command.steam: Track Steam builds and official news
command.edit: Edit a subscription and reset its baseline
command.remove: Remove a subscription and its pending notifications
command.dayz: Add the four DayZ applications without duplicating existing subscriptions
command.status: Show Steam monitoring and delivery status
command.test: Send a sample notification without mentioning anyone
parameter.mode: Track builds, official news, or both (default: both)
parameter.news_app_id: Application to use for news (default: the tracked application)
error.generic: The operation failed. Check /steam status and the bot logs, then retry.
error.access: Only administrators of the configured Discord server can use this command.
error.steam: Steam is not connected yet. Check /steam status and retry shortly.
error.app: The Steam application is unknown or inaccessible. Check the AppID and Steam account access.
error.branch: That branch has no accessible build or requires a password. Use /steam branches to check.
error.id: Application IDs must be positive 32-bit integers.
error.duplicate: A subscription already exists for this application, branch, and channel.
error.channel: Choose a text or announcement channel in the configured Discord server.
error.permissions: The bot needs View Channel, Send Messages, and Embed Links in that channel.
error.role: Choose a mentionable role from this server other than @everyone, or grant the bot Mention Everyone in the destination channel.
error.role_conflict: Choose either a role or clear_role, not both.
reply.saved: Subscription #{id} saved for {name}. The current state is the baseline; historical updates will not be posted.
reply.empty: No subscriptions configured. Use /steam follow or /steam dayz.
reply.no_branches: No branches are accessible for this application.
reply.dayz: DayZ preset ready: {added} subscriptions added; {skipped} existing subscriptions kept. Check /steam status for inaccessible branches that need Steam account access.
build.title: Steam build updated
news.title: Official Steam news
test.title: Vaporator test notification
test.body: Build and official news notifications will appear here. This test does not mention any roles.
cli.saved: Steam session saved. Protect the data directory and restart the bot.
cli.news_probe: Application {app_id}: {count} official articles in the past {days} day(s).
cli.about: Discord notifications for Steam builds and official news
cli.data_dir: Persistent database and Steam session directory
cli.run: Run the Discord bot and Steam monitors (the default command)
cli.login: Sign in locally with Steam Guard and save a reusable session
cli.probe: Inspect live Steam build metadata without connecting to Discord
cli.news: Check official Steam news without connecting to Discord
cli.days: Number of days of news to inspect (1 to 365)
health.preset_branch: Application {app_id}: public branch inaccessible; run steam-login and check account access
health.steam_connection: Connection failed. Check networking or renew the session with steam-login
health.delivery_channel: Cannot send to channel {channel}; check bot permissions
